#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

long long invl(long long a, long long mod) {
    if (a <= 0 || a % mod == 0) return 0;
    // Extended Euclidean algorithm to compute modular inverse
    long long b = mod, x = 1, y = 0;
    while (b) {
        long long t = a / b;
        a -= t * b;
        swap(a, b);
        x -= t * y;
        swap(x, y);
    }
    x %= mod;
    if (x < 0) x += mod;
    return x;
}

void solve() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    long long inv = invl(m + 1, MOD);
    long long ans = (1 + inv * n) % MOD;
    long long base = inv * ((long long)m * (m + 2 + (n - 1)) % MOD) % MOD;
    long long u = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        u += invl(i, MOD);
        u %= MOD;
    }
    ans = (base * u + ans) % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
